BiblicalUsage: Neziah is a family of temple servants, named in both return lists beside Hatipha, with no story beyond the name. The children of Neziah come back from exile and are counted among those who serve the house.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the name is enough: the children of Neziah returned, and their service is written down even though their deeds are not.
